title: RentGuard Renters Policy Card Service Charge on Catch-Up Payments
content:
## Fee tariff — card service charge on the catch-up (RentGuard Renters Policy)

Card service charge on the catch-up: when no renters payment by card was received in the last 12 calendar months, the catch-up carries the tier's card installment service charge; when one or more but fewer than 4 renters payments by card were received in the last 12 calendar months, it carries the tier's EFT installment service charge; when 4 or more were received by card, it carries no card service charge. The charge carried is added to the catch-up amount.

Payments counted are payments received on the renters policy's premium account with card as the method of payment, posted within the last 12 calendar months.

| Renters card payments received, last 12 calendar months | Card service charge on the catch-up |
|---|---|
| None | The tier's card installment service charge |
| 1 to 3 | The tier's EFT installment service charge |
| 4 or more | None |

Boundaries: 3 card payments carry the tier's EFT installment service charge; 4 carry none. A first card payment moves the charge from the card service charge to the EFT service charge.

The two service charges are the per-installment service charges of the policy's RentGuard tier.

*Hypothetical case:* a policyholder who paid by card twice in the past year carries the tier's EFT installment service charge on the catch-up; one who paid by card five times carries none.
